I will not buy chemical fertilizer for my beans because they fix their own nitrogen and a bag of DAP costs more than I can spare after paying school fees for my grandchildren. I will carry two wheelbarrows of cow manure from my brother's cows and work it into the soil before planting, since I own this plot and want to keep it fertile for my daughter to inherit later. I will plant the bean seed I saved from last season's harvest, not new bought seed, and my daughter and I will weed this 0.33-hectare plot by hand over about 26 days this season because hiring labor is too expensive for a small plot like mine.
